description: This script manages prebuilt tools by extracting tar files, refreshing timestamps, and verifying directories for a build environment, primarily used in build automation workflows.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates the modification timestamps of files in a directory and its subdirectories, excluding symbolic links.

methods.name: extract_prebuilt_tar
methods.description: Extracts a tar archive containing prebuilt tools.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps of build directories and verifies their existence, used to indicate updates in build state.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts prebuilt tools from a tar archive and refreshes relevant directory timestamps.
